title: Spring constant calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the spring constant using the initial equilibrium condition with both masses.

title: Amplitude determination
description: Essential: Correctly identifies the amplitude as the difference between the initial stretch and the new equilibrium stretch for mass A alone.

title: Maximum acceleration derivation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the maximum acceleration using the restoring force at the amplitude or the SHM formula.

title: Equilibrium analysis for A
description: Important: Identifies the new equilibrium position for mass A after the string is cut.

title: SHM principles application
description: Important: Recognizes that after the cut, mass A undergoes simple harmonic motion about its new equilibrium.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Converts all masses to kg and lengths to meters for calculations, or correctly handles units in final answers.

title: Sign error in force balance
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign in the force balance for the new equilibrium or the maximum restoring force.

title: Amplitude misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly states the amplitude as the initial stretch (15 cm) or the new equilibrium stretch (2.5 cm).
